name: heph
description: Hephaestus (heph) for Claude Code: project briefing at session start, live sessions, test detection, auto-diary, DECISIONS.md sync, new-project and migrate-project skills.

heph_url.title: Heph agent URL

heph_token.title: Heph API token
heph_token.description: API token from Heph Settings > Connect Claude Code. Kept in the system credential store.
